scope: Stateless genesis feature upgrade eligibility: exact signed roster and first 24-hour interval, independently pinned prior feature, monotonic replay and current host join proofs. No durable activation, freshness, writer readiness, daemon routes or CLI integration.
suite_authorship: A separate author used the accepted contracts, public fixtures and independent Python signing helpers, without inspecting either Go or Rust implementation. Only the new linking_features.py suite was authored.

coverage: Raw and SSH root proposals, exact single/multiple-host rosters and signed acknowledgments
Inclusive issue time, last valid second, exclusive 24-hour deadline and future proposals
Signed direct/invite membership, unbound hosts, removals, host leave/revocation and exact administrator kept statements
Catalog presence cannot supply the prior durable pin or bypass first interval/roster checks
Known matching feature survives expiry and all original host departures; later hosts need exact join proof
A separately admitted B forces complete root-to-B history to supply its feature acknowledgment; missing activation and pinned descriptor mismatch reject
Unused activation candidates remain inert; first enablement refuses circular linking evidence
Strict encodings, shapes, transport IDs, semantic aliases, decoded 512KiB boundary, framing and recovery
